name: Public Grievance Form
description: Form for lodging a public grievance with a government department in India.

fields.name: complainant_name
fields.description: Full name of the person lodging the grievance.

fields.name: ministry_or_department
fields.description: The government ministry or department the grievance is related to (e.g., Railways, Telecom, Health, Municipal Corporation).

fields.name: grievance_description
fields.description: Detailed description of the issue or complaint.

fields.name: pincode
fields.description: 6-digit postal PIN code of the complainant's address.
